correctness.rationale: An independent finite pairing identity reduces the odd product to G(2^(2e)A(A+1)). An elementary dyadic induction proves v2(G'(0))=e-2 exactly. The divided-difference quotient stays congruent to G'(0) mod 2^(2e+1), giving an exact factorization and valuation for all signed A,B, including collision boundaries. Distinct residue fibers and powers follow from parity and repeated squaring. Actual executable verifier results corroborate finite cases.
